places.name: Capitol Complex
places.description: Landmark civic complex designed as part of Le Corbusier's planned city of Chandigarh.
places.unesco_note: Part of The Architectural Work of Le Corbusier, a UNESCO World Heritage property.

places.name: Open Hand Monument
places.description: Symbolic monument representing peace, reconciliation and the principle of giving and receiving.
places.unesco_note: Located within the UNESCO-listed Capitol Complex.

places.name: Rock Garden of Nek Chand
places.description: Distinctive garden created from reused and discarded materials by Nek Chand.

places.name: Sukhna Lake
places.description: Man-made lake and major landscape landmark associated with Chandigarh's planned urban design.

places.name: Government Museum and Art Gallery
places.description: Important cultural institution housing archaeological, historical and art collections.
